name: server-normal-v5
note: Protocol v5 (docs/NAVRH_PROTOKOL_V5.sk.md; package B4, lead's skeleton dokazy/B4/kostra/KOSTRA.md). Schema 3 is the v5 layout: scripts/protocol_v5.py reads every section; python3 scripts/collection.py --protocol config/collection-v5.json selfcheck checks the file and its plan. A value a later stage determines (proposal 10.9) is null or preliminary at its one place, and determined_at names the stage of each such path. The numbers of the G0 rows of proposal 10.9 are the author's proposal by judgment; the owner may change them before G1.
vms_note: The two lab VMs of config/collection-v4.json: one image (scripts/labctl.py clone from hyptcn-guest, Debian 12, kernel 6.1.0-42-cloud-amd64), every service deployed on both; the scenario decides the traffic only (proposal 5.2).

invalid_rows.note: Preliminary until G2 (POKYNY 2026-11-22 section 4): max 3 and the gate 557/720 above, bound by the inequality (ideal - 33 (max + 1)) / cycles < gate <= (ideal - 33 max) / cycles; G2 determines max by the formula of proposal 10.9 (at most 6) and the gate follows from it.

replacement.note: Proposal 7.5: the limit is the smallest number with a predicted probability of completing the plan of at least 0.95 at the rejection rate of the confirmatory rehearsal; null until G3b. A replacement keeps the VM, role, group, position, scenario and the event types or control kinds in order, and draws new times and a new traffic seed with its attempt number (proposal 7.3).

scenario_rule.basis: rate is the peak of the arrival envelope: the share peak_share of the throughput measured at saturation in G2 for the scenario's intensity; the mean follows from the envelope
scenario_rule.note: Peak shares 0.3 and 0.8 are the author's judgment (skeleton section 1); the peak-to-mean ratio of at least 2 is proposal 5.7 (author's proposal, judgment). The lab test on the VM after B5 checks the rule before G2 fixes rate.

arrivals.note: The envelope of the open loop (proposal 5.3, skeleton B5 section 2; scripts/host_traffic.py draw_envelope), drawn from the session's traffic seed over [0, dur]: a linear ramp from level 0 over [0, ramp_s], inside the warmup; one slow wave mean * (1 - amplitude * cos(2 pi (t - start) / period)) with the period in wave_period_s (20 to 40 minutes, skeleton section 2), the mean in wave_mean, the amplitude in wave_amplitude and the start of a cycle in [warmup, warmup + period); one short peak of level 1 lasting peak_s (2 to 4 minutes, skeleton section 2), a trapezoid whose two flanks take peak_edge_share of it each, inside [warmup, dur]. An envelope whose peak-to-mean over [warmup, dur] is below scenario_rule.min_peak_to_mean is drawn again. The envelope is piecewise linear with knots every step_s. ramp_s 120 is warmup_s; wave_mean, wave_amplitude, peak_edge_share and step_s are the author's judgment. peak_at uniform: the peak lies anywhere in [warmup, dur] (a sale).

client_errors.note: Deliberate client errors, share of all requests (proposal 5.3: 1 to 3 %; skeleton section 2: 2 %): after each request one follows with odds share / (1 - share), its status drawn from statuses: 400 a catalog page 0, 401 the cart with an invalid token, 404 the detail of a product beyond the catalog. The request log marks each with intended_status.

think_s.note: Before every request but the first of a user session: exponential with mean 7 s, cut at 70 s (proposal 5.7, TPC-W).

funnel.note: The funnel of skeleton section 2 (home, browse and search, detail, cart, order): home, then a number of catalog pages drawn uniformly from pages, each a search with search_share (a noun of the product names of lab/seed.py) or else a browse of a page drawn Zipf over the catalog pages of page_size products, each page followed by a number of product details drawn uniformly from details_per_page, each detail drawn Zipf over the products; after home, a page or a detail a static file follows with static_share, drawn Zipf over the static files of lab/seed.py. A user session orders with order_share of its intensity (proposal 5.7): a login (customer token), a number drawn uniformly from cart_items of the products it viewed into the cart, the cart, the order. Zipf has the exponent zipf_s (skeleton section 2). pages, search_share, details_per_page, static_share, cart_items and page_size are the author's judgment.

eshop.note: Profile eshop (proposal 5.2): customers' user sessions as a funnel against the catalog, the cart, the orders and the static files of the lab (lab/services.py, lab/nginx.conf; objects of lab/seed.py). order_share is proposal 5.7, zipf_s skeleton section 2. max_concurrent 500 is the author's judgment until the lab test on the VM (RIADENIE point 4): a user session of about 9 requests lasts about a minute, so about 60 x rate are in progress at the peak.

arrivals.note: The envelope of the open loop (proposal 5.3, skeleton B5 section 2; scripts/host_traffic.py draw_envelope), drawn from the session's traffic seed over [0, dur]: a linear ramp from level 0 over [0, ramp_s], inside the warmup; one slow wave mean * (1 - amplitude * cos(2 pi (t - start) / period)) with the period in wave_period_s (20 to 40 minutes, skeleton section 2), the mean in wave_mean, the amplitude in wave_amplitude and the start of a cycle in [warmup, warmup + period); one short peak of level 1 lasting peak_s (2 to 4 minutes, skeleton section 2), a trapezoid whose two flanks take peak_edge_share of it each, inside [warmup, dur]. An envelope whose peak-to-mean over [warmup, dur] is below scenario_rule.min_peak_to_mean is drawn again. The envelope is piecewise linear with knots every step_s. ramp_s 120 is warmup_s; wave_mean, wave_amplitude, peak_edge_share and step_s are the author's judgment. peak_at wave_start: the peak begins where a cycle of the slow wave begins (its lowest level), the login wave at the beginning of the slow wave (skeleton section 2): every corp user session begins with a login.

client_errors.note: Deliberate client errors as in eshop (proposal 5.3, skeleton section 2), in the forms of corp: 400 a document list page 0, 401 a login with a wrong password, 404 a document id that never exists.

think_s.note: Exponential with mean 10 s, cut at 100 s, the author's judgment: an employee reads a document longer than a customer a page (proposal 5.7 fixes the think time of eshop only).

document_sizes.note: Upload sizes, lognormal with a Pareto tail (skeleton section 2): with tail_share a Pareto size from tail_from_bytes with index tail_alpha, else lognormal with the median median_bytes and sigma; cut to [min_bytes, max_bytes], max_bytes the 8 MiB cap of the docs service (lab/services.py MAX_DOCUMENT). The numbers are those of the seeded documents (lab/seed.py document_size, the B5a executor's judgment).

corp.note: Profile corp (proposal 5.2): an employee logs in with a password (lab/seed.py employee_password), then takes a number of document actions drawn uniformly from actions, each drawn by shares: a document list page (drawn Zipf over the pages of page_size documents), a download (drawn Zipf over the seeded documents), an upload (document_sizes) or a report request, which the worker runs as three subprocesses and whose status the employee checks once. Zipf has the exponent zipf_s. The login wave is arrivals.peak_at wave_start. actions, shares, page_size, zipf_s and max_concurrent 250 are the author's judgment (max_concurrent until the lab test on the VM).

events.note: Five types and the empty event (decision D8). A session has no event or three; exactly one session of every group has none (proposal 5.5, 7.2). Durations are drawn continuously in duration_s; the free time of the session is split at random over all gaps. first_s 300, min_gap_s 480, tail_s 360 and grace_s 60 are the author's judgment (skeleton section 4): the gap is the reverberation of 300 s plus one full window of 160 s and a reserve, the tail the reverberation and the fading of the stop, the start the first window and two minutes of scored clean traffic. min_per_type is the table of proposal 7.2 (judgment by proposal 10.9).

full_snapshot_guard.note: Proposal 5.5: no event and no control starts from before_s before a full snapshot to the first scored row after it, that is the full snapshot's row + window_rows (judgment by proposal 10.9).

controls.note: Controls on the VM, classes A (edge) and B (volume), proposal 7.4: 7 controls and 7 paired negatives per kind, at least 60 s each, horizon 180 s from the start, only in role test_controls with three slots per session; 70 controls fill 70 of the 72 slots and the plan records the two empty ones (skeleton section 6). Durations as the events (B8 skeleton). B8 adds the doses, columns and expectation of each kind. The numbers are the author's judgment by proposal 10.9.

streams.rule: seed = int(sha256(json.dumps([name, group, session, attempt, purpose])).hexdigest()[:16], 16) with the protocol name (the rehearsal's own name in rehearsal mode); session-level purposes (event_times, traffic, traffic_arrivals, traffic_choices, traffic_sizes) take the group name, the position and the attempt; role-level ones (event_free_position, event_deck, control_deck) the role name as group, session -1 and attempt 0; scenario_order is drawn per block of len(scenarios) groups of a role, with group <role>/<block>, session -1 and attempt 0
streams.note: Every purpose has its own random stream (proposal 5.5); the seeds are new, the v4 schedule was looked at during the fault analysis (proposal 7.3). The traffic of a session (package B5b, skeleton B5 section 2): traffic draws the arrival envelope and is the session's seed, traffic_arrivals the arrival times, traffic_choices the choices of every user session and traffic_sizes the upload sizes (scripts/host_traffic.py).

periodicity.note: author's judgment in G0 (proposal 10.9), not a mechanism; the spacings are those between the starts of bursts of flagged rows (lead's remarks on B3, part 2)

background.note: Background activity of corp (proposal 5.7: the author's proposal without a direct source): outside every event window at least one successful login and one accepted report request, and the largest document download at least 10 times the median one (a long tail of sizes); the three numbers are the author's judgment (package B5b).

traffic.note: The bounds of the realism requirements (scripts/traffic_log.py realism) and of the offered-load check, G0 by proposal 10.9. Proposal 5.3: the offered load outside event windows within 20 % of the plan. Proposal 5.7: arrival spacings with a coefficient of variation of 0.8 to 1.2, computed on spacings rescaled by the planned envelope (skeleton B5 section 4); the most requested tenth of the objects gets at least half of the requests; at least 88 % and less than 100 % successful answers outside events; response sizes over at least two orders of magnitude. The think-time mean and the order share may differ from the profile's design value (profiles, proposal 5.7) by at most 4 standard errors of their sample (the sample standard deviation over the square root of the count; for the order share sqrt(p (1 - p) / n) of the design share p): a two-sided test whose false refusal is about 6e-5 per session under the normal approximation, the author's judgment (package B5b). The peak-to-mean bound is scenario_rule.min_peak_to_mean.

invalid_rows.cause: rows invalid only because a named traversal did not close
invalid_rows.decision: invalid_rows rule of the protocol (owner 2026-11-17): at most max such rows, never scored

rule_closed_rows.cause: process lists a parser rule closed (prev, tail, meet)
rule_closed_rows.decision: complete lists, only reported; rule_closed_rows_max caps them from G3b

unconfirmed_findings.cause: cross-view differences seen in one snapshot only
unconfirmed_findings.decision: a difference of the live read is a finding once the next snapshot confirms it

inconclusive_integrity.cause: integrity checks that could not conclude
inconclusive_integrity.decision: integrity availability is no behaviour input (features/quality.py)

collector_warnings.cause: collector warnings that match an allowed pattern
collector_warnings.decision: audit.warnings_allowed, determined in G2; null allows none

event_traffic_exit.cause: traffic generator exit code 1 in an event session
event_traffic_exit.decision: failed requests inside an event window are evidence of the event

event_unit_restarts.cause: units an event type restarts by design (EVENT_UNITS)
event_unit_restarts.decision: any other restart stays a problem

event_window_requests.decision: inside [host start - 1 s, host stop done + grace] failures are expected

event_window_health_checks.cause: health polls without request id inside a window
event_window_health_checks.decision: lab/udalosti.py polls health without a request id

event_window_journal.cause: tracebacks and worker errors inside a window
event_window_journal.decision: outside every window they reject the session

event_window_nginx_errors.cause: nginx error lines inside a window
event_window_nginx_errors.decision: outside every window they reject the session

architecture.note: The TCN of the current code (proposal 10.1 point 3) on the collection window.

stopping.note: Proposal 8.3: when the selected epoch is the last one, training is repeated once with twice the cap. Patience 10 and the cap of 100 epochs are the author's judgment.

Z0.what: never alarms; random alarms at the matched alarm rate

Z1.what: a threshold per column on its value, first difference, rolling mean and CUSUM; also a threshold on mem_changed_max

Z2.what: some count differs from its mode

Z3.what: prediction by the last value, the window mean and EWMA, nothing learned

Z4.what: a threshold on the offered load; regression of the features on the load

Z5.what: linear autoregression (ridge) on the same window

M.what: the TCN of architecture, seeds 0 to 4

analysis.selection: One procedure on dev for every method with free parameters: the grid point with the best value of the method's own criterion on dev (prediction loss for Z3, Z5 and M; alarms per observed hour at the matched threshold for Z1, Z2 and Z4), ties to the first grid point; never on a test role (author's judgment, proposal 8.3).

k2a.statistic: D = share of detected interventions of M minus that of Z per boot

k2b.statistic: D = share of detected interventions of M minus that of Z per boot

interventions.validity: every column, its first difference and rolling mean inside train quantiles

analysis.note: The analysis plan of proposal 10.1 point 3 (chapters 6.4, 7.4, 8.3, 8.4): the model enters K1 and K2 by its median over the five seeds, the deployed bundle is seed 0 (D14); fpr 0.01 and the rule 3 of 5 are kept (chapter 12); K1 against the prediction methods, K2a against the threshold methods, K2b against the methods with time and no learning; an occurrence is evaluable when at least half of its first 60 s is scored; a type or class with fewer than 8 evaluable occurrences is not evaluated. The bounds m are set in G1, the grids and the column mask in G3a. The numbers of the G0 rows are the author's judgment by proposal 10.9.

rehearsal.note: Proposal 10.4 and POKYNY 2026-11-22 section 4 (question 10): a rehearsal is a mode of this file, with its own name and group prefix and 2 groups per role (10 groups, 30 sessions, every role on every VM); its scenario counts differ by at most 1 over the whole plan (skeleton section 6).
